enum: Source product report on its supported rate scale; a qualified native zero is not physical absence.
Source cofactor-consumption report; reporter turnover alone does not establish productive chemistry.
Descriptive identified-product per consumed-cofactor comparison of selected source rates.
Stoichiometric productive fraction of the selected reaction system, distinct from molecular attribution.
The same productive-fraction component displayed in percent.
The author-reported coupling statistic on percent scale, preserving original source meaning.
Displayed-rate arithmetic minus author-reported coupling in percentage points; no rounding/error penalty inferred.
Same-source product-rate reconstruction; original product contribution, not independent validation.
First-order variance of the descriptive ratio under the supplied joint selected-estimate covariance.
Fixed-nu first-order productive-fraction variance; conditional fixed-substitution term when nu is uncertain.
Square root of the same fixed-nu variance term, not a confidence interval or function probability.

enum: Selected source quantity; scientific eligibility for combination is separate.
Endpoint rate after the additional supported contaminant subtraction only.
Applicable nuisance-condition test/reference response, excluding the intended change.
Measured endpoint rate per selected molecular amount; not contaminant-isolated or nuisance-corrected.
Reporter-calibrated measured endpoint per selected molecular amount; not contaminant-isolated or nuisance-corrected.
Compiled source-endpoint activity under the selected calibration, amount, attribution and nuisance-control meanings.
Conditional first-order propagated effect variance plus the selected distinct residual variance.
Square root of conditional effect variance, not an inferred confidence interval.
Reciprocal conditional effect variance; dependent on the same source measurements.
Existing conditional known-normal nonnegative-presence profile; not a probability of function.
Existing proposed bounded transform of that conditional profile; not annotation credit.
First-order variance propagated from the actual joint operands of measured_endpoint_per_selected_amount; excludes distinct residual variability and uncertainty of other estimands.
Square root of the first-order propagated variance of measured_endpoint_per_selected_amount; excludes distinct residual variability and uncertainty of other estimands.
First-order variance propagated from the actual joint operands of calibrated_measured_endpoint_per_selected_amount; excludes distinct residual variability and uncertainty of other estimands.
Square root of the first-order propagated variance of calibrated_measured_endpoint_per_selected_amount; excludes distinct residual variability and uncertainty of other estimands.
First-order variance propagated from the actual joint operands of corrected_activity; excludes distinct residual variability and uncertainty of other estimands.
Square root of the first-order propagated variance of corrected_activity; excludes distinct residual variability and uncertainty of other estimands.
Native selected source report; qualified nondetection is not exact physical absence.
Descriptive contrast of the selected identified-product endpoint, not molecular effect isolation.
Descriptive reporter-turnover contrast; reporter consumption alone does not establish product formation.
Relative productive use of the selected reporter; reuses both product and reporter measurements.
Relative fitted saturation turnover of the selected constructs under their stated protocols.
Relative low-substrate efficiency under the selected kinetic interpretation; not an observed physiological rate.
Reference occupancy under the declared one-site/free-substrate model.
Test occupancy under the declared one-site/free-substrate model.
Relative occupancy under the declared binding model, not relative catalytic activity.
Signed discrepancy between product contrast and the occupancy-only alternative.
Relative activity remaining after the modeled occupancy difference; its cause is not identified.
Log discrepancy with the occupancy-only alternative; not a causal fraction or function probability.
First-order variance of that log discrepancy, using the actual joint selected-estimate owners.
Signed standardized discrepancy under the declared uncertainty model; no reference distribution assumed.
Squared standardized discrepancy under the same model; not a p-value or independent contribution.
Relative post-binding activity under the declared multiplicative response model with actual applicable background, recovery, active-fraction and nuisance operands.
